description: Search public Morereply polls by words in the question or options, or by author username (@name). Returns up to 20 polls with status, vote totals and, where visitors may see them, option percentages. Only polls that are voting or closed are searchable. Use get_poll for one poll's full detail.

language.description: Only polls written in this ISO 639-1 language, e.g. en, es, fr, pt

limit.description: How many polls to return, 1 to 20

query.description: Words to find in poll questions or options, or @username for an author's polls

status.description: Only polls in this state: voting (open) or closed

name: search_polls

language.description: ISO 639-1 language the poll is written in

id.description: Option id; pass it to vote

percent.description: Share of the poll's option votes, 0 to 100; absent while results are hidden

votes.description: Votes for this option; absent while results are hidden

results_visible.description: False when the poll hides per-option results from visitors right now

status.description: scheduled, option_collection, reviewing, voting, closed or cancelled

your_vote.description: The option the connected user voted for; absent for guests and when they have not voted

title: Search polls
